summary: Tested 'Elimina richiesta' (Da classificare), Super Admin restore, and Copertura oraria counting only confirmed people on TEST_DcOrg. Backend: 6/6 pytest pass. They cover the coverage lifecycle (da_classificare -> volontario confermato -> rinunciato -> staff confermato -> da_classificare), seed people never in fasce/legacy, 404 for no request or unknown person/event, deleting a request when the person is also confirmed on EV2 (person kept, EV2 coverage unchanged), deleting an orphan (person moved; 403 for org admin on list/restore; SA list shows staff+persons+availabilities; restore brings everything back; second restore 404), and audit da_classificare_deleted/restored. UI desktop: the Da classificare row shows 'Elimina richiesta' next to invite/edit/delete. The dialog text is exact ('Vuoi eliminare la richiesta di UiDel TEST_UiDel per l'evento TEST_Ev Dc? ...'). Annulla closes without deleting. A person with 2 events gets the event select, and the text follows the chosen event. Confirm removes the row, the count goes 5->4 and the toast 'Richiesta e anagrafica eliminate' shows. Org admin does not see 'Richieste eliminate'. As SA (acting org TEST_DcOrg) the list shows the batches and Ripristina brings the row back (count 3->4). Coverage UI: classifying via the edit mask as Volontario keeps stato da_contattare, so fx-avail stays 0. After setting stato confermato (only possible via API), fx-avail M/P = 1, the fx-open list shows TEST_UiCov, and switching to Staff keeps 1. Exports (xlsx fasce/summary) contain only the confirmed person. cov-print-fasce and cov-print-fasce-names download. Staff/Volontari/Team/Gruppi/Turni tabs load without errors. Found 1 major UX gap (no UI to set stato), 1 mobile gap and 1 minor restore bug.

minor.issue: Restore only checks doc id. If a new da_classificare link was created for the same person+event after deletion (e.g. a new public-form submission), restore creates a DUPLICATE da_classificare link on the same event. Reproduced: links after restore = [('da_classificare','da_contattare') x2]. PUT /staff forbids this duplicate (409). Same risk for availabilities.

Candidate people are taken from every staff link with a matching ruolo, with no categoria/stato filter. So Da classificare or unconfirmed people can get their availability bulk-updated, although they never appear in coverage. Consider applying the same CONFIRMED_CATS + stato=='confermato' filter.

ui_bugs.issue: The 'Elimina richiesta' action is missing on mobile/tablet (<768px). It exists only in the desktop table actionsCell (it is in the DOM but not visible at 390px), so mobile users cannot delete Da classificare requests.

integration_issues.flow: Confirming a person for Copertura oraria
integration_issues.issue: Coverage now needs staff.stato == 'confermato', but there is NO admin UI to set a link's stato. PersonMask has only Ruolo (categoria), and new links from the mask/Aggiungi Staff/Volontario are created with stato 'da_contattare'. STATO/STATO_COLOR in Persons.jsx are defined but never rendered, and PersonDetailDialog has no stato select. Result: anyone added manually, or a public-form registration whose availability is not 'confermata', can never enter Copertura from the UI. Only public-form people (stato copied as confermato) or API edits count. The review asks to verify 'via the edit mask (categoria + stato)', but the mask has no stato field. Existing orgs whose staff are 'da_contattare'/'disponibile' will see their coverage drop to 0.

issues: Data di nascita uses the native browser date input (mm/dd/yyyy) instead of the shadcn calendar (pre-existing)
Once a person is classified, the Ruolo select no longer offers 'Da classificare', so there is no UI way back to Da classificare (may be intended)

action_items: HIGH: Add a per-event 'Stato' select (Da contattare/Disponibile/Confermato/Rinunciato/...) in PersonMask event rows (e.g. data-testid mask-assign-stato-{i}) and/or a status badge+quick change in the Staff/Volontari tables. Otherwise no UI user can confirm people, and Copertura stays empty for manually added staff. Decide whether classifying from Da classificare to Staff/Volontario should default to confermato.
MEDIUM: Add the DeleteRequestButton to the mobile card actions (Persons.jsx ~l.270) when tab === 'da_classificare'.
LOW: In restore, skip or merge staff/availability docs when a link with the same persona_id+evento_id+categoria already exists, to avoid duplicates.
LOW: Apply the confirmed filter to bulk-fascia candidates.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 14.6k lines; the da-classificare delete/restore block should live in its own module like coverage.py.
da_classificare_delete moves the availabilities only when no other staff link remains on that event. Good, but a rinunciato/team link keeps the availability (acceptable).
_require_sa_org depends on require_admin, so SA needs X-Org-Id. OK, and the list is org-scoped.
A leftover batch 'Altro TEST_Altro · TEST_Ev Dc' (deleted 22:36 by the main agent) is still in deleted_requests. I left it untouched.

success_rate.frontend: ~85% (desktop flows pass; mobile action missing; no stato UI)
